name: Annihilator Attack Helicopter
summary: Military-grade attack helicopter with side-mounted miniguns and rocket pods. Used by LCSO pursuit helicopters at 5-star wanted levels in Leonida.
description: The Buckingham Annihilator is a military-grade attack helicopter drawing from the AH-64 Apache design language. Armed with side-mounted miniguns and underslung rocket pods, it appears as the LCSO's heavy pursuit asset at 5-star wanted levels across Leonida State. Its armored airframe withstands significant small-arms fire and its weapons systems can disable vehicles rapidly.
